# Skill: Draft PR and Review Readiness

## Objective

Enforce a draft-first PR lifecycle to improve review quality and reduce unstable merges.

## Execution Checklist

- [ ] Open PR as Draft
- [ ] Complete PR template fields (issue, milestone, labels, validation)
- [ ] Keep PR scope aligned to the linked issue only
- [ ] Convert to Ready for Review only after checks pass

## Exit Criteria

- PR has clear summary and risk notes
- Acceptance criteria are explicitly addressed
- Reviewer can verify with provided commands and outputs
